name: interop-basic
build:
git init -q -b main . &&
printf 'alpha\n' > a.txt && mkdir -p dir/sub && printf 'beta\n' > dir/sub/b.txt &&
printf 'run\n' > run.sh && chmod +x run.sh && ln -s a.txt link.txt &&
printf '*.log\n' > .gitignore &&
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' git commit -q -m 'initial import' &&
printf 'alpha2\n' >> a.txt && git add a.txt &&
GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112912000 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112912000 +0000' git commit -q -m 'second commit' &&
git tag -a v1.0 -m 'release 1.0' && git tag light HEAD~1 &&
git branch topic HEAD~1
probes: git clone -q @REPO@ @WORK@/clone 2>&1; echo exit=$?; git -C @WORK@/clone log --format='%H %s'; git -C @WORK@/clone status --porcelain; git -C @WORK@/clone fsck; echo fsck=$?

name: interop-names
build:
git init -q -b main . &&
mkdir -p 'dir with space/inner' &&
printf '1\n' > 'dir with space/inner/file one' &&
printf '2\n' > 'quote"name' &&
printf '3\n' > 'utf8-\303\244\303\266' &&
printf '4\n' > empty && : > truly-empty &&
mkdir -p nested/a/b/c/d && printf '5\n' > nested/a/b/c/d/deep &&
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' git commit -q -m 'unusual names'
probes: git clone -q @REPO@ @WORK@/clone 2>&1; echo exit=$?; git -C @WORK@/clone log --format='%H %s'; git -C @WORK@/clone status --porcelain; git -C @WORK@/clone fsck; echo fsck=$?
